name: Lydia
title: Western Liberators
description: The deputy commander of the Western Liberators. She always supports Ceres at her side. Though she wears a cheerful smile at all times, a darkness lurks behind it.
introduction:
Deputy Commander of the Western Liberators.
While supporting her hardline commander Ceres, she plays a major role in keeping the Western Liberators from becoming overly rigid.

With her flawless efficiency and gentle kindness, Lydia is popular with both the Liberation members and the western refugees, but to some members she is considered an even more terrifying superior than Ceres. When asked to elaborate, however, they reportedly turn pale and cannot speak.
Though she is always smiling brightly, some feel there is something unsettling about that smile.
